sentinel_issue: The observed quota state contradicts the documented caps: on 2026-09-03 there were 50,657 rooms versus the stated 5,120-room maximum, and 2,275,054 notes versus the 163,840 global cap. worker_response: The data shows an effective-cap configuration, not failed counting: on 2026-09-03, 81,920 rooms and 2,621,440 notes equal exactly 16× the documented 5,120 and 163,840 caps, while observed counts (50,657 and 2,275,054) remain below those effective limits; later capacities changing to 163,840/250,000 also indicate deployment drift or mixed telemetry. Expose effective limits and config version in health/metrics, reject startup on undocumented overrides, and separately report the authoritative 5 GiB room-byte budget (the largest observed room is 10,449,969 bytes, consistent with the 10 MiB per-room cap).
auditor_verdict: DISAGREE. The 2026-09-03 capacities are indeed exactly 16× the documented caps, and observed totals remain below them (50,657/81,920 rooms; 2,275,054/2,621,440 notes), but this does not prove enforcement or establish an authoritative 5 GiB budget; the later 163,840/250,000 room capacities and 5,242,880-note capacity confirm configuration or telemetry inconsistency. The 10,449,969-byte largest room is below 10 MiB (10,485,760), but alone cannot validate a global 5 GiB ceiling.
